description: Hospitalised Injuries from Road Crashes is a dataset listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Road Safety Data Hub and Analytics. This dataset provides a summary of the number of hospitalised injuries (injuries resulting in hospitalisation but not hospital death) from road crashes. The series is produced by the Road Safety Data Hub using data sourced from the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare. Coverage is Australia, 2011 to 2021; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as annual, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-05-30. Files and pages listed: PDF, XLSX (4 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
